SELECT reg_date as date, ROUND(COALESCE(nextDayRetentionUsers * 100.0 / NULLIF(newUsers, 0), 0), 1) as nextDayRate, ROUND(COALESCE(day7RetentionUsers * 100.0 / NULLIF(newUsers, 0), 0), 1) as day7Rate, ROUND(COALESCE(day30RetentionUsers * 100.0 / NULLIF(newUsers, 0), 0), 1) as day30Rate FROM ( SELECT DATE(um.create_time) as reg_date, COUNT(*) as newUsers, COUNT(DISTINCT nextday.member_id) as nextDayRetentionUsers, COUNT(DISTINCT day7.member_id) as day7RetentionUsers, COUNT(DISTINCT day30.member_id) as day30RetentionUsers FROM ums_member um LEFT JOIN ums_member_login_log nextday ON um.id = nextday.member_id AND DATE(nextday.create_time) = DATE_ADD(DATE(um.create_time), INTERVAL 1 DAY) LEFT JOIN ums_member_login_log day7 ON um.id = day7.member_id AND DATE(day7.create_time) BETWEEN DATE_ADD(DATE(um.create_time), INTERVAL 6 DAY) AND DATE_ADD(DATE(um.create_time), INTERVAL 7 DAY) LEFT JOIN ums_member_login_log day30 ON um.id = day30.member_id AND DATE(day30.create_time) BETWEEN DATE_ADD(DATE(um.create_time), INTERVAL 29 DAY) AND DATE_ADD(DATE(um.create_time), INTERVAL 30 DAY) WHERE um.create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND um.status = 1 GROUP BY DATE(um.create_time) ) retention_calc ORDER BY reg_date

SELECT '高活跃' as level, COUNT(*) as count FROM ums_member um WHERE um.status = 1 AND um.create_time <= #{endDate} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ums_member_login_log umll WHERE umll.member_id = um.id AND umll.create_time BETWEEN DATE_SUB(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND #{endDate} GROUP BY umll.member_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(umll.create_time)) >= 5 ) UNION ALL SELECT '中活跃' as level, COUNT(*) as count FROM ums_member um WHERE um.status = 1 AND um.create_time <= #{endDate} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ums_member_login_log umll WHERE umll.member_id = um.id AND umll.create_time BETWEEN DATE_SUB(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND #{endDate} GROUP BY umll.member_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(umll.create_time)) BETWEEN 3 AND 4 ) UNION ALL SELECT '低活跃' as level, COUNT(*) as count FROM ums_member um WHERE um.status = 1 AND um.create_time <= #{endDate} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ums_member_login_log umll WHERE umll.member_id = um.id AND umll.create_time BETWEEN DATE_SUB(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND #{endDate} GROUP BY umll.member_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(umll.create_time)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2 ) UNION ALL SELECT '沉睡用户' as level, COUNT(*) as count FROM ums_member um WHERE um.status = 1 AND um.create_time <= #{endDate} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ums_member_login_log umll WHERE umll.member_id = um.id AND umll.create_time BETWEEN DATE_SUB(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND #{endDate} )

WITH base_data AS ( -- 浏览商品 SELECT '浏览商品' as name, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) as value FROM ums_member_login_log WHERE create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND member_id IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
-- 加入购物车 (添加日期限制，使用创建时间或最后修改时间) SELECT '加入购物车' as name, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) as value FROM oms_cart_item WHERE member_id IS NOT NULL AND (create_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} OR modify_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate})
UNION ALL
-- 下单 SELECT '下单' as name, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) as value FROM oms_order WHERE create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND status != 4
UNION ALL
-- 支付 SELECT '支付' as name, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) as value FROM oms_order WHERE create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND status IN (2, 3) ) SELECT name, -- 确保漏斗数据合理性：每一步不能大于前一步 CASE WHEN name = '浏览商品' THEN value WHEN name = '加入购物车' THEN LEAST(value, (SELECT MAX(value) FROM base_data WHERE name = '浏览商品')) WHEN name = '下单' THEN LEAST(value, (SELECT MAX(value) FROM base_data WHERE name = '加入购物车')) WHEN name = '支付' THEN LEAST(value, (SELECT MAX(value) FROM base_data WHERE name = '下单')) ELSE value END as value FROM base_data ORDER BY FIELD(name, '浏览商品', '加入购物车', '下单', '支付')
